source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_003],

I appreciate the prompt reply. We are preparing to submit a financial model to the government for a possible PPP project. One major requirement is to clearly show and substantiate why availability-style payments are needed for the project to be viable and bankable.

For your assessment, I have attached the Excel template and further project information. Please confirm whether you can help us develop the model. It may contain errors, so we need you to review them and make the model professional, clear, and strong.

value_updates.formula_and_link_behavior: Formulas and links must operate correctly between worksheets, with model errors reviewed and corrected.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: please review the model thoroughly and make any changes you consider helpful for improving it. ultimately, the figures must be logical and appear credible

value_updates.calculated_output_standard: Model figures must be logical and credible.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], i accidentally released $100 to you for the deliverable. Would you be able to return part of that payment? The spreadsheet contains numerous problems, and i had to engage another freelancer to redo the work from the scratch. I would prefer not to leave you a negative review. please refund the amount to me, because keeping it would not be fair. The work you provided cannot be used. Please respond and let me know.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the delivered spreadsheet contains numerous problems, cannot be used, and must be rebuilt from scratch.

References from the presentation to the working model describe presentation traceability rather than formula or worksheet-link integrity.
